referenced_urls.title: GitHub - caru-ini/stack-diagram: Agent skill: describe your stack in a sentence, get an architecture diagram with official logos

media.description: Generated architecture diagram (light theme): user to Next.js on Vercel, Hono API on Cloudflare Workers, Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, Upstash, Clerk auth and GitHub Actions deploy, with official logos.
Generated CI diagram (dark theme): developer push to GitHub Actions publishing to npm, with a pnpm workspace of Lefthook, Biome, Turborepo and Vitest.
Generated RAG chat diagram (dark theme): Next.js chat UI on Vercel calling Claude, Supabase pgvector search, Inngest nightly sync from Notion.
